summary: Karman Line Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering. On August 19, 2026, it sold 20,000,000 units at $10.00 each, generating $200 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant, exercisable at $11.50 per share. The company entered into standard agreements, including an underwriting agreement with Cohen Company Capital Markets. This is a routine IPO closing report, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, advisor recommendations, or strategic events beyond the offering itself.
